decision: Reject both 80-epoch expansion4 admit models for promotion
training_findings: Both admit seeds learned all five reviewed hard TRAIN crops and retained over 98 percent ordinary training accuracy. This resolves the earlier learnability question but does not establish generalization.
development_findings: On the 67-frame panel, both admit seeds lost five blue true positives relative to the unchanged parent and matched controls. Blue false positives increased from parent 13 to 15 and 14; red false positives increased from 4 to 5 and 6. The other panels do not establish a consistent improvement.
next_action: Acquire and visually review more diverse real TRAIN balloon scenes with source attribution and cross-dataset duplicate checks before another matched training experiment. Do not continue increasing emphasis on the same five hard examples.
scope: Repeated development panels, not independent qualification. No claim of a model capacity ceiling.
